name: Nairobi Securities Exchange Plc
source: Nairobi Securities Exchange Plc audited group results for the year ended 31 December 2025 Filled 2026-10-01 from the kenyanstocks.com comprehensive income API: Income Tax FY2024 from the source line Tax Expense; Income Tax FY2025 from the source line Tax Expense. | CRON 20261014: H1 2026 column added from Nairobi Securities Exchange Plc unaudited financial statements for the six months ended 30 June 2026, page 1 (KShs thousands read as absolute KES): total income 1,210,292; total operating expenses 309,748; operating profit before expected credit losses and fair value movements 900,544; provision for expected credit losses and bond mark to market (30,769); share of gain of associate 136,568; profit before tax 1,006,343; tax expense (269,471); profit after tax 736,872; basic and diluted EPS 2.82 on a weighted average 261,662,319 shares. Gates tie: total income less total operating expenses equals 900,544 and profit before tax less tax equals 736,872. Source URL https://www.nse.co.ke/wp-content/uploads/Nairobi-Securities-Exchange-Plc-Unaudited-Financial-Statements-for-the-6-months-ended-30-June-2026.pdf
source_note: Kshs'000 x1000 to absolute KES. Top line is total income (levies, data, interest and other income), not sales revenue. 2024 expense line items foot to 672,575 but the printed total is 673,267 (issuer 692,000 gap); printed total retained. | Operating Profit (EBIT) FY2025 read from NSE-PLC-Audited-Financial-Statements-For-The-Year-Ended-31-December-2025-1.pdf | Operating Profit (EBIT) FY2024 read from NSE-PLC-Audited-Financial-Statements-For-The-Year-Ended-31-December-2025-1.pdf | The row labelled Operating Expenses held [null, 322,114] (the issuer other operating expenses, 2024 only) and the panel alias matched it, so the real Total expenses row never rendered. That row is deleted and the Total expenses row is relabelled so the printed FY2025 total 741,453 and its FY2024 comparative 673,267 both render.
